subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------ MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-4 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) opening Braxton's diagnostic of late-seventies western culture: 'we are creating the future now.' (C)LK-IMP (the concept of linkage implications) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information): the question is what linkage-implication produces when crossed with multi-information — the linkage at issue being the connection between American black-culture conditions and world-cultural significance, the multi-information being the spectrum of perceptual claims (the prose lists an NBC poll, women's-liberation rhetoric, black-middle-class commentary) that constitute late-seventies western culture's self-image. TH-CONT (thrust continuance) anchors the upper-right output. SO-EXP-PRI hangs on the right margin. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from the main line and carries both TH-CONT, which leads to SO-EXP-PRI and on to IST-F, and INFO-DE. (P)DIFF (point of idea completion for difference) sits below the central axis, on a line from INFO-DE that leads on to (R)POL-DY. IST-F (isolated focus) anchors the right output. (R)POL-DY (the reality of political dynamics) anchors the lower-center. INFO-DE (information degrees) hangs on the lower-right. The (r) prefix on POL-DY commits that political-dynamics actually obtains.
